description: This is a Lua script for a graphical application that displays an image and moves it within a window, updating position based on velocity and handling window boundaries.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application by creating a window and loading an image logo.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the current frame, including background, image, and position text, updating the position of the image and handling boundary collisions.
